## 🐛 Bug Description

Clear and concise description of the incorrect behavior.

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `themis init --repo .`
2. Run `themis run-cycle --role planner`
3. Observe the error

## ✅ Expected Behavior

What should have happened instead of the error.

## 📋 Additional Context

- Themis version: v1.0.0
- Operating System: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.11]
- Branch: [main / english]

## 📎 Evidence

Screenshots, logs, or traces if applicable.
